title: Memory Transfer Learning (MTL) for AI Coding Agents
summary: A framework from KAIST that enables AI coding agents to transfer knowledge across heterogeneous domains. It improves performance by extracting high-level strategic insights from task trajectories rather than reusing low-level traces.
research_notes: Developed by KAIST AI in collaboration with NYU and DeepAuto.ai; demonstrates a 3.7% performance boost across multiple coding benchmarks.

evolution.summary: The project was officially published on arXiv (2604.14004) in April 2026. It represents a shift from single-domain self-evolution to unified cross-domain memory pools, validated on next-gen models like GPT-5-mini and Qwen3-Coder.
